body.x: Patchworks(www.patchworksonline.com), a developer of mobile accessories including screen protectors and cases for iPhones and Android devices, unveils its entire line of ITG glasses at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.ITG(Impossible Tempered Glass) is a brand name for Patchworks' tempered glasses. As a pioneer in developing tempered glass screen protector, Patchworks' tempered glasses gained No.1 sales in Japan with the accumulated sales of 1,279,152 units in the past two years.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
